correctness.rationale: For every k>=1 and targets (s,t) modulo 2^k of matching parity, the 5-term mixed-parity base at k=2 lifts via two independent top-bit toggles (add 2^k to one entry; move +/-2^(k-1) between opposite-parity entries). Each operation preserves lower bits and both tuple parities, proving all k by induction. The target (2,0) is not a 4-fold sum modulo 8: square-sum zero forces every entry even and the first coordinate divisible by 4. k=1 gives order 1 and k=2 gives order 3 (explicit 3-term construction). Confirmed exhaustive finite sumsets k=1..7 in independent program; not used as infinite proof.
